author: Mattboxx
tagline: One map for Apple Find My and Google Find Hub trackers.
description:
One self-hosted workspace for the Apple Find My and Google Find Hub
trackers you own: local location history, source comparison and isolated
user accounts. Latest/history maps with persistent 24-hour, 7/30-day and
custom date/time filters. Reversible views for two or more trackers,
retaining every original identity, history and settings.

Manage names, colors, hidden devices, order, owners and guarded key rotation.
Generate identities before choosing to add a device. Background polling,
optional MQTT/Home Assistant discovery and optional existing Traccar map.
Selective JSON export, full admin backups, ESP32/Nordic flashers, portable
downloads and optimized configured FindMyAdv library. Responsive EN/IT UI
with illustrated bilingual guides.

Google reliable positions use consensus, clustering and anti-teleport
analysis, with confidence and STALE labels. Original reports remain in
an immutable paginated archive: Optimized, Raw and Both views are available.
Administrator parameters live in Setup; developer controls stay discreet.

Unofficial integrations, not GPS or guaranteed live tracking. Sightings
depend on contributing phones and provider policies. Screenshots show
synthetic demonstration data, not personal locations.

tips.before_install:
This application uses unofficial reverse-engineered integrations and is
not affiliated with Apple or Google. Use dedicated accounts and only
trackers you own. Apple onboarding requires SMS 2FA. Google onboarding
requires a secrets.json generated with the upstream desktop login flow.
Optional local API tokens can be configured from the app settings.

title: Find My Hub
release_note: Reliable Google locations: consensus, anti-teleport, confidence and STALE, with an immutable raw archive and Optimized/Raw/Both views. Admin parameters in Setup; developer tools at the bottom. MQTT/Traccar current states use reliable locations. Keys and firmware unchanged.
